subject.name: Moss Skimmer
subject.description: A small stylized hover skiff for an exploration game: rounded hull, mossy green panels, brass trim, two side fins, compact rear thruster, readable front/back orientation.

stages.title: Single concept image
prompt: Draw one production-ready game asset concept image for the Moss Skimmer.
Subject: a small stylized hover skiff for an exploration game; rounded hull, mossy green panels, brass trim, two side fins, compact rear thruster, readable front/back orientation.
Use a clean three-quarter view, front-left angle, neutral studio lighting, readable silhouette, opaque warm gray background.
Keep the object centered with enough margin for cropping. Make the asset feel usable in a browser canvas game.
Avoid text, logos, UI labels, background scenery, dramatic poster lighting, motion blur, and characters.

stages.title: Front side back turnaround
prompt: Draw a three-view orthographic turnaround sheet for the same Moss Skimmer hover skiff.
Use exactly three separated views in one row: front view, side view, back view.
Keep the same rounded hull, mossy green panels, brass trim, two side fins, and compact rear thruster across all views.
Use flat neutral lighting, identical scale, clean outlines, opaque light gray background, no perspective camera, no shadows crossing panel boundaries.
Avoid text, labels, logos, characters, decorative scenery, and extra views.
checks: front side back are the same object

stages.title: 2D sprite atlas
prompt: Draw a 2D sprite atlas sheet for the same Moss Skimmer hover skiff.
Create a clean 4 columns by 3 rows grid of 12 sprites, equal cell size, consistent anchor point, consistent scale.
Sprites should show game-ready top-down or slight isometric variants: idle, hover, bank left, bank right, accelerate, brake, damage, repair glow, turn left, turn right, boost, destroyed shell.
Use a perfectly flat chroma-key green background (#00ff00), clear gutters between cells, no shadows crossing cells, no labels, no text, no UI, no decorative background.
Every sprite must be the same object with the same mossy green panels, brass trim, side fins, and rear thruster.

stages.title: 3D model reference sheet
prompt: Draw a text-free 3D modeling reference sheet for the same Moss Skimmer hover skiff.
Show four clean orthographic views: front, side, top, and back. Also show one small shaded three-quarter preview in a corner.
Keep geometry simple enough to model: rounded main hull, two side fins, brass trim strips, compact rear thruster, mossy green material blocks.
Use a plain opaque light gray background, consistent scale across views, flat lighting for the orthographic views, no perspective distortion in the four reference views.
Avoid text, labels, logos, characters, scenery, dramatic lighting, exploded diagrams, and extra unrelated objects.
checks: front side top back are consistent
useful as image-to-3D or Blender reference
